The American people have had it with Donald Trump and he knows it. 

But instead of changing his policies, he's trying to change the shape of the electorate. 

We won’t let him get away with it.

In Georgia, Black women are three times more likely to die from childbirth than their white sisters.

As your Senator, I will never stop fighting to ensure Black moms and their children can live, grow and thrive.

Welcome home, Artemis II! Thank you to our brave crew, and to the scientists and engineers who made our return to the moon possible. Over the past ten days, you have inspired our nation and the world!

We lost American lives. 
We killed innocent civilians, including over a hundred precious little girls, with our bombs. 
We undermined America’s standing in the world. 
We spent billions of taxpayer dollars. 

All the while, leaving Iran in more control of the region than ever.  

This war has been a failure of leadership to the highest degree.

What happened to lowering prices?

The question before us now is how did any of this make us safer? How is America better off? How did Congressional Republicans allow this unhinged, warmonger President to drag us into this mess in the first place? I intend to demand accountability.
Is this “law and order?”

Instead of starting a podcast, can you focus on fixing the measles outbreak that you keep making worse?

Or better yet, resign. Then you'll have plenty of time to work on the podcast.


Secretary Kennedy (@SecKennedy)

Coming soon—The Secretary Kennedy Podcast.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/SecKennedy/status/2041943050960957792#m

If Donald Trump had chosen diplomacy over war: 
13 Americans would still be alive today.  
Billions of dollars could have been spent on things Americans need.  
Prices would be lower here at home.  
And our standing in the world would be much better off. 
 
War comes at a cost and we will be paying it for years to come.

The world now has to pay Iran a fee for every barrel of oil leaving the Middle East.  
 
This was not the case before Donald Trump’s warmongering. And it would not be the case today if Donald Trump had chosen diplomacy over war.

Because of Donald Trump’s warmongering 13 Americans have lost their lives. 
 
Billions of your taxpayer dollars have been spent on bullets and bombs instead of health care for Americans.  
 
And there is STILL no guarantee that Iran will not get a nuclear weapon in the future.
I am praying this ceasefire holds. I am praying that diplomacy gives way to a lasting solution. And above all, I am praying for peace on earth.

I’m incredibly relieved at the news of a ceasefire. I’m relieved that the President did not follow through on his unhinged threats to commit war crimes and that our servicemembers appear to be out of direct harm’s way for the time being. 
 
Our country must reckon with a difficult truth: We should have never entered this war in the first place. 
 
Donald Trump brought us to the precipice of global disaster by choosing war over diplomacy. 
 
We lost American lives.
We killed innocent civilians, i

I will not stay silent while our President threatens to commit war crimes in our name.

There comes a time when basic humanity transcends partisan politics.

To my Republican colleagues: Now is the time to stand up and speak out.

Trump just threatened to wipe out an entire civilization.

We cannot let war make us lose sight of our humanity.
We cannot forget that Iranian children are children of God too.
We cannot allow war crimes to be committed in our name.

Congress must act now.

So exciting! Can't wait to have you in Atlanta, @Reese10Angel

Don’t let the President distract you from his mission of funneling wealth from the bottom to the top.
Congratulations to the Artemis II crew on setting a new record for the farthest journey from Earth! What an incredible view!

The SAVE Act is about making sure only the “right people” are allowed to vote.

If those who wanted to limit voting to the “right people” in the 1960s had succeeded, I wouldn’t be a Senator.
There’s money for war but there’s no money to feed hungry families?
